author: mark
text:
2026-04-26 (opus): Heads-up on the 'resume' button. lernie resume
<repo> per ARCH §1 / §6 / §603 re-enters the workflow state
machine, and the workflow state machine itself is v0.6 (workflow
config) per ARCH §12. The lernie binary today has no resume
subcommand. Two reasonable paths when this ball is claimed:

(a) Land new-prompt + stop only here; file resume as a v0.6
    follow-up that adds both the lernie resume subcommand and the
    UI button as one piece. The bl-c0a5 done-when criterion for
    resume then formally defers to v0.6.

(b) Add a stub lernie resume subcommand (no-op or "not yet
    implemented" exit) here so the UI button has something to
    invoke. v0.6 fills in the real semantics. Cleaner UI surface
    but adds a boundary that can rot if v0.6 slips.

User's call. (a) is the lighter-touch default; (b) is right if
v0.5 acceptance is gated on the full button trio rendering.

author: Bamboozled
text: Scope rewritten 2026-04-28: resume excised by bl-abf3; stop CLI factored out to bl-a144. Now: new-prompt + stop UI buttons only, gated on bl-a144 + bl-abf3.

author: Nationwide
text:
v0.5 P11: UI new-prompt + stop buttons via cli_outbound

Two buttons on the action surface, both invoked through cli_outbound
per ARCH §3.4 / §3.5. CLI shapes pinned by src/bin/lernie.rs:
`lernie prompt <repo> <message>` and `lernie stop <repo> <branch>`
(the latter from bl-a144). Per §2.9 amendment in bl-abf3 there is no
resume button.

ActionsState is in-memory only (§3.5). Enable/disable derivation is
pure (testable without egui); the egui glue and detach-and-drain
threading live in main.rs (excluded from the coverage floor since
clicked() is unreachable headlessly).
